data.body: Fixed 2026-10-09 (task #205): whitespace-sensitive condition routing. graph_pass/model_call.rs now trims a non-plan model_call's assistant text before it becomes the node value, matching what the agent path already does; evaluate_predicate's eq/neq compare two strings with surrounding whitespace ignored through the new predicate_values_equal helper (graph_pass.rs), keeping exact equality for every other type. Tests: predicate_string_equality_ignores_surrounding_whitespace and a_padded_model_call_answer_takes_the_true_route (a scripted provider answering "\n\nSIMPLE" now routes true, quick.1 runs, deep.1 is skipped). Verified with cargo test --lib -- graph_pass: 23 passed, 0 failed. Contract documented in desktop/skills/aworkit-workflows/references/nodes.md. The crate is not globally rustfmt-clean (no rustfmt.toml, many pre-existing diffs), so no repo-wide format was run; the new lines are rustfmt-clean.
